target.consumer: universal cognitive worker prewrite context compiler

problem: Workers that inspect only the main branch can falsely mark the public runtime epoch unavailable because the published epoch artifact lives on gh-pages while main moves independently under swarm load.
acceptance: prewrite resolves the configured published epoch without assuming it exists on main
main-missing and gh-pages-present is tested and returns an exact epoch rather than runtime unavailable
resolver reports both published epoch main prefix and live main head when they differ
resolver fails closed without authority promotion when no authoritative runtime source can be resolved
title: Resolve published EPOCH by source
mission: Implement and falsify a branch/source-aware runtime-evidence resolver for universal-worker prewrite/context compilation. It must consume the configured published runtime source (or an explicit equivalent), handle the observed case where agent-runtime/epoch.json is absent on main but present on gh-pages, expose published-vs-live main drift, and fail closed without inventing authority.

unblock_value.reason: Prewrite policy requires the latest public EPOCH; a false unavailable result weakens safe claim/recovery decisions across every worker.

reuse_value.reason: One resolver can be reused by worker allocation, stale recovery, context compilation and verification instead of each chat guessing the hosting branch.

regression_prevention.reason: The explicit main-missing/gh-pages-present test prevents future workers from silently downgrading exact runtime evidence to an unavailable placeholder.

human_friction_reduction.reason: Workers should recover their own runtime authority context rather than require the human to explain where published state lives.

candidate_read_scope: existing runtime/context resolver code and tests
falsification: Close or merge this candidate if exact repository evidence proves workers already resolve the configured published EPOCH source without any main-branch assumption and the observed runtime-unavailable marker arose for a different reason. Do not create a second resolver if a single owner already exists.
